items.sentence: On [MASK], Complainant filed an EEO complaint alleging that the Agency discriminated against him based on disability (diabetes and liver fibrosis) and in reprisal for prior protected EEO activity (requesting a reasonable accommodation) when he was terminated, effective July 28, 2021.
The decision concluded that Complainant failed to prove that [MASK] subjected him to discrimination as alleged.
Complainant began his employment with the Agency on [MASK], with a Competitive- Career Conditional Appointment, which required him to be a probationary employee for one year.

In a progress review dated [MASK], the person listed as Complainant’s first-level supervisor stated that Complainant was not performing at the fully successful level 3 or above and listed areas for improvement, including becoming familiarized with the onboarding and payroll processes and timely completion of assignments.

In three emails from [MASK], S3 (third level supervisor, Program Coordinator) emailed Complainant regarding some performance issues, including partial or missing pay for two employees in Complainant’s service area, the payroll processing for pay period 11 of that year, and the status of several new hires.
